biography.plain_text: Serge Borenstein is a Belgian property developer, co-founder and president of Prague's Karlín Group. After working in advertising and real estate in Belgium, he moved into Czech development and helped transform former industrial sites into offices, housing and mixed-use districts. His projects are known for adaptive reuse, prominent architects and long-term urban regeneration.

long_biography.plain_text:
A short visit to Prague in the early 1980s gave Serge Borenstein an enduring interest in the city. Trained by experience in Belgian advertising and property brokerage, he returned as Czechoslovakia opened to private investment. An aerial view drew him to Karlín, then a neglected industrial district, where he first pursued advertising sites before acquiring land for development.

Borenstein co-founded Karlín Group in 1997 and became its president. Working with Czech and international architects, he turned factories and brownfields into offices, homes, cultural venues and mixed-use neighbourhoods while retaining elements of their industrial character. Projects including Corso Karlín helped establish adaptive reuse as the company's signature and made Borenstein a central figure in Prague's post-communist urban transformation.

uncertainties.detail: Identity is resolved at confidence 100 because a Czech government document matches the exact 23 March 1949 birth date, while official and independent sources match the Belgian nationality, Prague residence, uncommon name and Karlín Group career. A French property-company record for a Serge Borenstein born in March 1949 may concern the same person, but it is not needed for resolution and is not used for biography or wealth claims.

Current Radio Prague coverage and a detailed industry interview identify Borenstein as Belgian-born, supporting Belgium as birth country. No reliable source reviewed gives a city of birth, so place_of_birth remains blank. The already stored exact birth date is independently verified and is not re-proposed.

Self-made is supported by Borenstein's advertising and real-estate work, first Prague acquisitions and co-founding of Karlín Group, with no evidence of inherited core assets. The sources also mention an important outside investment partner but do not disclose family background, starting capital or transaction terms, so neither Self-made — independent start nor Self-made — advantaged start is asserted.

Karlín Group's current site identifies Borenstein as a current partner and president, and current press calls him the group's owner and head. Public sources do not disclose his exact equity percentage or the full current partner structure, so the dossier avoids quantifying control.

The exact LinkedIn profile lists a Karlín Group presidency starting in 1991, while the official company site dates the group's formation to 1997. The profile is accepted for identity and current role, but the official company date controls the biography and classification chronology.

Real Estate is selected for both wealth fields because property development is the documented founder-built and current platform. Commercial real estate is the minimum useful active tag because offices and mixed-use income-producing property form a defining part of the portfolio. Inactive Brownfield redevelopment, Urban development, Real estate entrepreneur and Real estate executive tags are excluded.

The exact LinkedIn and official Karlín Group person page clear verification. No defensible personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was found. A Czech Wikipedia page exists, but the higher-quality official company profile and LinkedIn already provide the minimum useful profile set.

All vessel names, ownership periods, specifications, values, movements and holding structures are excluded from both biographies and all wealth classifications. Private addresses and document numbers, current project disputes, property valuations and personal net-worth estimates are also omitted.
